Five taps, one screen

Name, source, outcome, save. Source stays selected between calls because agents work in batches from one list.

Choosing "Appointment set"

Reveals the date field inline and writes the appointment row in the same save. Two records, one action — otherwise the appointment log stays empty and the funnel lies.

What the top strip does

  • Counts against the daily minimum the SMD set
  • Shows the streak, informational — never a nag
  • Updates instantly; the SMD's view catches up within a minute

Offline

Calls queue on the phone and sync on reconnect. Agents call from cars and basements.

Installs to the home screen as a PWA, so it opens beside the dialer rather than in a browser tab.
